summary: Both blocks observe the real host opener (xdg-open/$BROWSER recorders on PATH): documented keys parsed from getting-started.md trigger the opens, _send_opener_key_while_unopened rejects any open before the key, and exact-equality assertions prove the artifact path (data_root/artifacts/task_id/plan.md, plus byte match) and PR URL (== task url, canonical pattern) handed to the opener.
